description: Gate 1 (bean c4uz): does the Weinberg cosh-vs-cos +1.1% gap reduce to a toroidal-Legendre Q_{nu-1/2} torus-saddle identity? Derive-first gate — verdict: no-reduction found (gate closed for now). The N=2 trace ratio is EXACT (no saddle-correction series exists), and the same-index replacement Q_{9/2}/Q_{13/2} is structurally excluded by degree-monotonicity of Q_nu (Laplace rep, DLMF 14.12.4): the Q-ratio is > 1 for every eta_0 > 0 while both targets are < 1. Includes the one prescribed observation-tier evaluation (item 3).

data.verdict_scope: Scope-limited stop, NOT a general refutation of toroidal-Legendre machinery. Excluded (scope (b), invariant cited): the same-index bare replacement Q_{5-1/2}/Q_{7-1/2} for cosh(5 eta_0)/cosh(7 eta_0), by degree-monotonicity of Q_nu at fixed argument > 1. Not excluded: toroidal-Legendre structures at the colored/large-N saddle level (where the Askey two-saddle table actually operates), or index assignments derived from a future colored-level analysis.

caveats: The N=2 trace ratio P_W/P_Z is exact (no asymptotic series), so no steepest-descent correction applies at this level; the 1.1% gap is not addressed by this gate.
